Driver board is round, 57 mm dia, 4 x M2.5 holes (2.5 mm), mini-HDMI (11.5 wide) and micro-USB (8 wide) on the edge opposite the flex connector, each angled 15 deg - so they splay apart. Mount each LCD + board turned 180 deg (LCD flex at the top, plugs pointing down) and flip the picture on the Pi with a 180 deg display rotation: flex-down puts the outboard plug only 8-10 mm from the barrel skin. The barrels' inboard walls are open above the camera slot so the LCD ribbon can swing past while you turn it. 5 V 1 A+
